title: Every hold has land to grant

sections.heading: Nobility
items: Jarls across Skyrim can now appoint lords and ladies. Until today only Bruma and Haafingar had fiefs, so every other Jarl was told that all fiefs were claimed.

Thirteen holdings join Underarch Harbor: Riverwood and Rorikstead in Whiterun Hold; Shor's Stone and Ivarstead in the Rift; Dragon Bridge in Haafingar; Kynesgrove and Darkwater Crossing in Eastmarch; Karthwasten and Old Hroldan in the Reach; Halfmoon Mill in Falkreath; Stonehills in Hjaalmarch; Anga's Mill in the Pale.
A holding's lord manages its buildings as a steward does, assesses and rents property there, and their own house there does not count against the one-building limit.
Winterhold has no holding to grant. The Great Collapse took its villages, and its Jarl grants the honour of Thane instead.
